comment:
* Helper functions to decode protobuf wire format from a byte array. * *

Note that these functions don't do boundary check on the byte array but instead rely on Java * VM to check it. That means parsing routines utilizing these functions must catch * IndexOutOfBoundsException and convert it to protobuf's InvalidProtocolBufferException when * crossing protobuf public API boundaries.

methods.name: static int decodeVarint32(byte[] data, int position, Registers registers)
methods.comment:
* Decodes a varint. Returns the position after the varint. The decoded varint is stored in
   * registers.int1.

methods.name: static int decodeVarint32(int firstByte, byte[] data, int position, Registers registers)
methods.comment: Like decodeVarint32 except that the first byte is already read.

methods.name: static int decodeVarint64(byte[] data, int position, Registers registers)
methods.comment:
* Decodes a varint. Returns the position after the varint. The decoded varint is stored in
   * registers.long1.

methods.name: static int decodeVarint64(long firstByte, byte[] data, int position, Registers registers)
methods.comment: Like decodeVarint64 except that the first byte is already read.
